chronicle_instance.title: PrecisionBOM: The Architecture of Liquid Truth and Thermodynamic Gating

meta.focus: Forensic reconciliation of the PrecisionBOM Hackathon strikes.
meta.philosophy: Logic is free; evolution has a cost. By decoupling state versioning from access logic, we instantiate a non-opinionated substrate for agentic commerce.

sections.title: I. The Innovation: Extensibility Without Opinion
content: The core breakthrough of the PrecisionBOM terminal is the synthesis of ERC-7827 (Value Version Control) and x402 (Payment Required).

Traditional blockchain protocols often embed business logic (subscriptions, access tiers) directly into the smart contract. This creates a rigid, opinionated substrate that is expensive to evolve and impossible to generalize.
Innovation: ERC-7827 is strictly a forensic container. It does not know what a 'subscription' is or what 'tokens' are used for. It merely records that a Key has changed to a Value over time.

Innovation: The x402 Layer is the gateway's logic. Because the substrate (7827) is non-opinionated, the PrecisionBOM server can implement complex, tiered logic—like our '50 tokens per AI strike' rule—entirely within the API layer.
This decoupling allows the substrate to remain stable while the business logic becomes liquid and infinitely extensible without requiring on-chain upgrades for every rule change.

sections.title: II. The Forensic Protocol: Identity Anchoring
content: We replaced the legacy email/password model with a cryptographic Clickwrap Handshake.
Handshake Strike: The user signs a bit-perfect legal/technical agreement. This signature is not a transaction; it is a proof of secret possession.
Sovereign Sessions: Upon verification, the server issues a JWT session grounded in the recovered 0x address. This anchors the user's presence in the terminal to their forensic on-chain record.

sections.title: III. Tiered Verification: The x402 Escalation Loop
content: The PrecisionBOM Gateway implements a three-tiered verification protocol to resolve payment requirements autonomously.
Tier 1: Forensic Registry (On-Chain Check). Direct lookup against ERC-7827.
Tier 2: Ledger Audit (Direct Hash & Scan). The server scans the Sepolia ledger for valid 0.001 ETH strikes, supporting both broad account scans and instant Direct Hash verification.

Tier 3: Auto-Write Sync (Self-Healing State). The server autonomously executes write strikes to synchronize ledger payments into the substrate, granting access and refilling capital in the background.

sections.title: IV. Thermodynamic AI: Sourcing Strikes
content: We grounded AI intelligence in a tangible economy via the '_tokens' substrate.
Strike Cost: Every interaction with the sourcing agent costs 50 tokens.
Deduction Strike: The agent deducts tokens from the substrate at the start of reasoning, grounding the 'effort' of the agent in the user's on-chain capital.

sections.title: V. Trust During the Session: Agentic Management
content: In the current implementation, token balances are managed optimistically by the server's agents during the active session.

Session Trust: The server maintains the local capital state to ensure zero-latency strikes. This 'Session Trust' allows for high-speed agentic reasoning while the slow-finality blockchain (Sepolia) moves in the background.
Agentic Custody: During the session, the user trusts the PrecisionBOM agents to accurately track and report deductions before the final state is anchored to the substrate.

sections.title: VI. The Optimistic Substrate: Dispute Resolution via Kleros
content: The ERC-7827 substrate functions as an 'Optimistic Receipt' of the agent's work.

Challenge Period: On-chain strikes are viewed as optimistic proposals of state. If a client does not dispute the work or the deductions within a set challenge period (e.g., a few days), the state becomes permanently anchored and indisputable.

Serious Oath Integration: Future iterations will leverage the 'Serious Oath' project for dispute resolution. If a user disputes an AI strike's quality or a token deduction, the evidence (forensic logs) will be submitted to Kleros.
Arbitration: Kleros jurors will act as the final forensic auditors, resolving disputes over agentic performance and ensuring that the Silicon Commons remains a fair and high-integrity environment.
